title: Appointment rescheduling
body: Northstar Health Network asks patients to request routine appointment rescheduling at least 24 hours before the scheduled time. Contact the scheduling team with the appointment reference.

title: Referral intake
body: For an administrative question about a pending referral, contact the referral intake team with the referral reference. The intake team confirms the required booking documents.

title: Billing support
body: Contact the billing team with the appointment reference to request an invoice correction.
